output.title: A slow payment provider
output.description: At three seconds the payment provider slows tenfold. Compare Checkout filling its threads with a 600 ms timeout: payments fail fast while Checkout keeps serving requests. Timeouts do not cancel the provider's work.

simulations.title: No timeouts
simulations.description: Checkout fills all 100 threads after the slowdown. Its queue keeps growing; the gateway eventually returns 504s after waiting five seconds.

simulations.title: A 600 ms timeout
simulations.description: Payments time out, then their late replies are discarded. Checkout releases each thread after 600 ms and the gateway never times out: degradation instead of a stall.
